$comment: Stall thresholds in minutes, per workflow slot, for scope-status.mjs. This is local policy a human sets once, not a cloud value: copy this file to ~/.config/catalyst-cloud/stall-policy.json and edit it there. A ticket counts as stalled when it has sat in a slot longer than the threshold with no update and nothing running or leased on it. 'dispatch' is how long a card may wait in the dispatch column before you ask why nothing picked it up; 'pr' is how long a card may wait for merge evidence; 'default' covers any slot not named.
